history.summary: SUB-SHRINE of seq 1770 (Ettumanoor Mahadeva Temple) - NOT an independent temple. The Krishna shrine (Krishnankovil) is a small temple dedicated to Lord Krishna standing just outside the main walls of the Ettumanoor Mahadeva complex, on its north-western side. It is listed alongside the Sastha, Dakshinamoorthy, Ganapathi, Bhagavati and Yakshi shrines of the complex. town_description: Ettumanoor is a municipality in Kottayam district, about 12 km north of Kottayam city on the Kottayam-Vaikom-Ernakulam route. It is known chiefly for the Mahadeva temple, a major pilgrimage centre and home to celebrated 16th-century murals. The town sits in central Kerala's midland belt of paddy fields, coconut groves and rubber plantations, and serves as a stop on the Vaikom-Ettumanoor-Kaduthuruthy Shiva-temple circuit.
